title: MaddieCraft
description: Client side improvements for maddiekuma minecraft server.
body:
Clientside improvements to use on the server mc.maddiekuma.com, contact John on discord for feedback and suggestions, feel free to disable any features you don't like.

![title screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/EUeWDaaO/images/f1e8eb47259c64177f11ca2ab7f3c792ab6efabb.png)

# Features:
- Improved visuals
- Longer render distance with LODs
- Vanilla plus shaders
- Improved sound engine
- Dynamic vanilla minecraft music depending on what you're doing
- Lots of extra sounds
- Polished UI animations
- Quality of life sorting features
